YOUR PARTNER IN FLAVOUR

Since 1985

Loved in Homes &

Restaurants.

Hanif’s is a family-owned business based in Vancouver, Canada. Since 1985, we have supplied a wide range of staple goods, spices and premium world foods to leading restaurants, caterers, supermarkets and independent stores.


Our products are loved and trusted by thousands of professional and home chefs worldwide. Our range is always evolving to match the latest trends in kitchens, and we have an extensive network of leading suppliers worldwide, so contact us for any other items you’d like to discuss
